scope: Primary-source artifact check for NIST hydrogen field-test standard and public NREL high-flow fueling evidence

sources.title: Hydrogen Field Test Standard Design, Operating Instructions, & Specifications
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

public_artifact_inspection.finding: The public 28-page technical note describes a local H2 FTS laptop reduction workbook and text DAQ files on the test computer, but the GovInfo/NIST public record exposes the PDF rendition only; no CSV/XLSX/logger archive or written reuse terms were found.

sources.title: Hydrogen Field Test Standard: Laboratory and Field Performance
reported_results: three 0.41 kg and four 0.75 kg hydrogen field drafts
laboratory and field method agreement reported as aggregate percentages

public_artifact_inspection.finding: The open full text contains protocol, aggregate results and plotted profiles, but no downloadable synchronized logger values or reuse terms.

sources.title: Overview of Record-Setting High-Throughput Hydrogen Fueling at NREL
reported_channels: dispenser/vehicle pressure traces in presentation figure
high-flow rate and fill mass summary

public_artifact_inspection.finding: The public H2IQ slide deck reports an 82.3 kg, 6 min 33 s high-throughput test with pressure and flow plots, but does not expose a machine-readable synchronized logger export.

sources.title: Hydrogen Fuel Dispensing for Medium- and Heavy-Duty Vehicles
reported_channels: station/vehicle pressure traces in presentation figure
multiple temperature traces in presentation figure

public_artifact_inspection.finding: The public deck reports a 73 kg, 423.5 s heavy-duty fill and plots pressure, temperature and mass-flow channels, but no raw synchronized archive or written reuse terms were found.

sources.title: SAE J2601 MC Default Bench Test Data
reported_channels: bench pressure/temperature/flow traces in workbook files

public_artifact_inspection.finding: The archive is downloadable and already quarantined locally for the consumed benchmark, but the landing page does not grant an open-data redistribution licence; it is not a new independent holdout and cannot be republished.

claim_boundary: NIST and NREL sources materially strengthen protocol, metrology and high-flow provenance, but none supplies the independently accessible synchronized station-to-vehicle raw archive required to clear the full-loop IJHE gate. Published figures and aggregate values are not converted into pseudo-raw validation data.
